_README: Fetch plan for the Energy-sector expansion: 20 companies in five subsectors, three most recent report editions each. Years are the years ResponsibilityReports.com actually hosts, discovered by reading each company's archive page -- not assumed from a URL pattern. Where fewer than three editions exist the shortfall is recorded here rather than padded with an older edition, so a company contributing two documents is visibly a two-document company. 'status' is filled in by absence/ingest_reports.py as each document is fetched; 'unavailable' entries stay in this file with their reason, per ABSENCE_BRIEF.md Section 4 (a failed fetch is logged and marked, never silently dropped).
_caveat_vintage: The three most recent editions are not the same three years across companies: Expand Energy reaches 2024 while Williams, Kinder Morgan, ONEOK, EQT, EOG, Marathon and Schlumberger stop at 2022. Any cross-company comparison over this corpus therefore mixes company differences with disclosure-practice drift over time. Compare within a year where possible, and never read a year gap as a company difference.
_caveat_site_sector: ResponsibilityReports.com labels XOM, CVX, COP and OXY 'Basic Materials'. The subsector field below follows the GICS-style Energy taxonomy requested for this assessment, not the site's labels.
